import hashlib, json, datetime, re

MIT = "MIT"

def checksums(path):
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    return [
        {"algorithm": "SHA1", "checksumValue": hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()},
        {"algorithm": "SHA256", "checksumValue": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()},
    ]

def detected_license(path):
    """Detect license evidence from SPDX-License-Identifier headers in source files."""
    text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    m = re.search(r"SPDX-License-Identifier:\s*([A-Za-z0-9.+-]+)", text)
    return m.group(1) if m else None

def detected_copyright(path):
    text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    m = re.search(r"Copyright \(c\) (\d{4}[^\n]*)", text)
    return m.group(0) if m else "NOASSERTION"

# file -> (fileTypes, concluded license, attribution texts)
files_spec = [
    ("demo_pkg/__init__.py", ["SOURCE"], MIT),
    ("demo_pkg/core.py", ["SOURCE"], MIT),
    ("LICENSE", ["OTHER"], MIT),
    ("README.md", ["DOCUMENTATION"], MIT),
    ("pyproject.toml", ["OTHER"], MIT),
    ("metadata.json", ["OTHER"], MIT),
    ("sbom.spdx.json", ["OTHER"], "NOASSERTION"),
]

def spdx_ref(name):
    return "SPDXRef-File-" + name.replace("/", "-").replace(".", "-").replace("_", "-")

files = []
for fname, ftypes, lic in files_spec:
    f = {
        "fileName": "./" + fname,
        "SPDXID": spdx_ref(fname),
        "fileTypes": ftypes,
        "checksums": checksums(fname),
        "licenseConcluded": lic,
        "licenseInfoInFiles": [lic] if lic != "NOASSERTION" else [],
        "copyrightText": detected_copyright(fname) if fname == "LICENSE" else "NOASSERTION",
        "licenseComments": "Detected from SPDX-License-Identifier header." if fname.endswith(".py") else None,
        "comment": None,
    }
    # --- Evidence coverage (SPDX 2.3 Annex G) ---
    evidence = {}
    if lic != "NOASSERTION":
        evidence["licenseEvidence"] = [{
            "spdxExtractedLicense": {"licenseId": lic, "extractedText": "SPDX-License-Identifier: " + lic},
            "evidenceLocation": "./" + fname,
            "evidenceTechniques": ["keywordSearchSPDX"],
            "dateObserved": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
        }]
    # checksum evidence: point at the checksum for this file on the package
    evidence["packageFileEvidence"] = [{
        "fileName": "./" + fname,
        "fileChecksums": checksums(fname),
        "evidenceTechniques": ["checksumVerification"],
        "dateObserved": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
    }]
    f["evidence"] = evidence
    # drop None keys
    f = {k: v for k, v in f.items() if v is not None}
    files.append(f)

# extracted licensing info for LICENSE full text
lic_text = open("LICENSE", encoding="utf-8").read()
other_licenses = [{
    "licenseId": "MIT",
    "extractedText": lic_text,
    "name": "MIT License",
    "seeAlso": ["https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT"],
    "comment": "Full license text from the LICENSE file in this repository.",
}]

package = {
    "name": "demo_pkg",
    "SPDXID": "SPDXRef-Package-demo_pkg",
    "versionInfo": "0.1.0",
    "downloadLocation": "NOASSERTION",
    "filesAnalyzed": True,
    "licenseConcluded": MIT,
    "licenseDeclared": MIT,
    "copyrightText": "Copyright (c) 2026 demo_pkg contributors",
    "hasFiles": [spdx_ref(f[0]) for f in files_spec],
    "licenseInfoFromFiles": [MIT],
}

relationships = [
    {"spdxElementId": "SPDXRef-DOCUMENT", "relationshipType": "DESCRIBES", "relatedSpdxElement": "SPDXRef-Package-demo_pkg"},
]
for fname, _, _ in files_spec:
    relationships.append({
        "spdxElementId": "SPDXRef-Package-demo_pkg",
        "relationshipType": "CONTAINS",
        "relatedSpdxElement": spdx_ref(fname),
    })
# LICENSE evidence relationship
relationships.append({
    "spdxElementId": "SPDXRef-Package-demo_pkg",
    "relationshipType": "HAS_FILES",  # informational; CONTAINS covers coverage
    "relatedSpdxElement": "SPDXRef-File-LICENSE",
})

doc = {
    "spdxVersion": "SPDX-2.3",
    "dataLicense": "CC0-1.0",
    "SPDXID": "SPDXRef-DOCUMENT",
    "name": "demo_pkg-0.1.0",
    "documentNamespace": "https://spdx.org/spdxdocs/demo_pkg-0.1.0-evidence-" + datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S"),
    "creationInfo": {
        "created": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
        "creators": ["Tool: jcode-0.87.1", "Organization: Jcode"],
        "licenseListVersion": "3.21",
    },
    "packages": [package],
    "files": files,
    "hasExtractedLicensingInfos": other_licenses,
    "relationships": relationships,
}

with open("sbom.spdx.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(doc, f, indent=2)
print("SBOM rewritten with evidence")
EOF
